ValidationRule.description: Rejected Contract Resubmission Date must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DMS") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup") )&& OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c)) || DATEVALUE(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(Rejected_Contract_Resubmission_Date__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rejected Contract Resubmission Date must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
